title: 第二十一章时间飞逝刀法大成第二十二章天大的机遇
content_zh:
;;
月光洒落。
“我今夜该去哪里睡？”江宁有些发愣，一时心中茫然。
突然间。
踏踏踏——
突然间，一连串且急促的脚步声在墙后响起。
就看到一道壮硕的身影从墙院之后显露出来。
“孙大姐！”江宁开口。
孙大娘看了一眼江宁，顿时就发现他头顶不断升起的热气，以及身上被汗水浸湿的衣裳。
“小家伙，你这也太吃苦了吧！这个时间点还在练功！！”她的眼神有些温柔。
江宁笑了笑：“既然选择了练功，那不就得吃点苦吗！我做为普通人家出生的孩子，能得到这个学武的机会不容易，必须要紧紧抓住这个机会。”
“再吃苦，你也得睡觉啊！这都午夜之时了，不好好睡觉养精蓄锐，你明天还怎么练功？”孙大娘有些生气的开口。
“是得睡觉！”江宁点点头。
看到江宁的点头，孙大娘脸上的神色顿时变得柔和。
“那你跟我来吧！早就为你为你铺好了床，刚刚就看到伱在认真看书，没忍心打扰你！”孙大娘有些絮絮叨叨的开口。
听着孙大娘的话，江宁脸上不由的露出淡淡的笑容。
俩人走到寂静的武馆，脚下是青砖铺成的道路。
月光如水，照射在地面上清晰可见两人的倒影，耳边不断响起各类昆虫的叫声。
穿过一间院子，走过几十米的道路，俩人就来到一個院子。
“武馆空置的房间比较多，这间院子就留给你一个人住，我就在隔壁！”孙大娘停在院子中开口道。

“多谢大姐！！”江宁抿了抿嘴，神色认真的开口。
孙大娘不由的笑了笑：“你都叫我一声大姐了！还谢什么呢！”
随即她又道：“对了，你的被子还没来得及晒，先将就一晚，每日给你晒一晒。”
“没事！”江宁脸上露出笑容：“我有一个床睡就行！来武馆学武又不是来享福的！”
“这你孩子也太懂事了！”孙大娘微微摇头说道，随即眼中又露出一抹回忆：“当年他也是跟你差不多的懂事！！”
“孙大姐，你口中的他是谁？”
孙大娘闻言顿时回神，她定了定神，摇摇头不做回答，反而开口道：“很晚了，你洗个澡就去睡觉吧！我也该回去睡了！”
在月光下，江宁看着孙大娘缓缓离开的身影。
“看来孙大姐也是一个有故事的人啊！！”江宁心中微叹，然后朝着自己的房间走去。
吱嘎——
推开房门。
整个房间一览无余。
房间并不大，大约只有四五十平，布局也很简单，只有基本的桌椅櫈，以及靠着墙角的红花木大床。

The moonlight shines.
"Where should I sleep tonight?" Jiang Ning was in a daze, feeling confused for a moment.
suddenly.
Tap tap tap——
Suddenly, a series of rapid footsteps sounded behind the wall.
I saw a strong figure emerging from behind the wall courtyard.
"Sister Sun!" Jiang Ning said.
Aunt Sun glanced at Jiang Ning and immediately noticed the rising heat above his head and the clothes on his body that were soaked with sweat.
"Little guy, it's too hard for you! You are still practicing at this time!!" Her eyes were a little gentle.
Jiang Ning smiled: "Since you have chosen to practice martial arts, don't you have to endure some hardships? As a child born in an ordinary family, it is not easy for me to get this opportunity to learn martial arts. I must seize this opportunity tightly."
"No matter how hard you endure, you have to sleep! It's already midnight. If you don't sleep well and recharge your batteries, how can you practice tomorrow?" Aunt Sun said angrily.
"You have to sleep!" Jiang Ning nodded.
Seeing Jiang Ning's nod, Aunt Sun's expression suddenly softened.
"Then come with me! The bed has been made for you a long time ago. I just saw you reading a book seriously and I didn't have the heart to disturb you!" Aunt Sun said naggingly.
Listening to Aunt Sun's words, Jiang Ning couldn't help but reveal a faint smile on her face.
The two of them walked to the silent martial arts hall, with a road paved with blue bricks beneath their feet.
The moonlight was like water, and the reflections of the two people could be clearly seen on the ground, and the sounds of various insects kept ringing in my ears.
After passing through a courtyard and walking dozens of meters along the road, the two of them came to a courtyard.
"There are many vacant rooms in the martial arts hall. I will leave this courtyard for you to live alone. I am right next door!" Aunt Sun stopped in the courtyard and said.
"Thank you, sister!!" Jiang Ning pursed her lips and spoke seriously.
Aunt Sun couldn't help but smile: "You already called me eldest sister! What else are you thanking me for!"
Then she added: "By the way, your quilt hasn't had time to dry yet, so I'll just leave it for one night and dry it for you every day."
"It's okay!" A smile appeared on Jiang Ning's face: "I just have a bed to sleep on! I don't come to the martial arts hall to learn martial arts to enjoy the blessings!"
"Your child is so sensible!" Aunt Sun shook her head slightly and said, and then a flash of memory appeared in her eyes: "Back then, he was almost as sensible as you!!"
"Sister Sun, who is he in your mouth?"
Aunt Sun suddenly came back to her senses after hearing this. She composed herself, shook her head and did not answer. Instead, she said: "It's very late. You can take a shower and go to bed! It's time for me to go back to sleep too!"
Under the moonlight, Jiang Ning watched Aunt Sun slowly leaving.
"It seems that Sister Sun is also a person with a story!!" Jiang Ning sighed in his heart, and then walked towards his room.

Push the door open.
The whole room has an unobstructed view.
The room is not big, only about 40 to 50 square meters, and the layout is very simple, with only basic tables, chairs and stools, and a large red flower wood bed leaning against the corner.
